summary: Redesign PMO forecasting, risk sensing, and reporting with responsible AI practices. Explore the course and plan your next step.
lede: AI-enabled PMO practice helps PMO heads, programme directors, and portfolio managers redesign governance and delivery services for responsible AI use. Participants learn to prioritize use cases and assess portfolio data and forecast assumptions, map risk-sensing and escalation workflows, and shape AI usage policies and stakeholder reporting prototypes, using practical exercises and reference frameworks including the NIST AI Risk Management Framework and ISO/IEC 42001.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for leaders and practitioners who shape project governance, portfolio decisions, and PMO services, and who need a practical approach to responsible AI adoption.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Practical experience in project, programme, portfolio, or PMO work is expected. Familiarity with project status reporting and basic portfolio governance will help. No coding or machine-learning experience is required. Advanced AI topics are addressed at operational application and governance level, not technical engineering level.
